Article.ArticleTitle: A fictional report whose PubDate is an imprecise MedlineDate range, never a specific day

Abstract.AbstractText: This is an unstructured abstract describing a wholly fictional study. No real company, drug, or patient data is described anywhere in this fixture. This fixture exists to exercise NLM's own MedlineDate free-text fallback (a range spanning two months), which this repository's Date Integrity contract correctly refuses to guess into a specific day, month, or even a single year.

AffiliationInfo.Affiliation: Department of Fictional Epidemiology, Sample University
